【原视频简介】
Enjoy this delicious homemade Aloo Frankie made with spicy potato filling, fresh vegetables, Schezwan sauce, and a soft homemade frankie roti. Crispy on the outside, flavorful on the inside, and packed with street-style flavors, this easy frankie is perfect for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or an evening snack.

🥙Ingredients

Potato Filling
• 3 medium potatoes
• 1 large onion
• 4–5 green chillies (adjust to taste)
• 1 tsp cumin
• Mustard oil (or any cooking oil)
• 1 tbsp ginger-garlic
• 1 tsp turmeric
• 1 tbsp chilli powder (adjust to preference)
• Chilli-Garlic Sauce or Schezwan Sauce
• 1 tsp sugar (optional)
• Salt to taste
• Fresh coriander

Frankie Roti
• 350 g all-purpose flour (or whole wheat atta)
• Salt
• A little oil
• Water (add gradually)

Frankie Roll Assembly
• Frankie roti
• Garlic Chilli Sauce or Schezwan Sauce
• Potato filling
• Raw cabbage
• Raw onion (optional)
• Fresh coriander
• Cheese (optional)
• Fried noodles (optional, for extra crunch)

For Cooking
• Oil
• Butter
• Garlic Chilli Sauce (optional, for brushing on top)

🥄To Serve With
• Garlic Chilli Sauce
• Schezwan Sauce
• Fried Noodles (Chinese Sev)
• Raw Onion
• Green Chillies
• Chilled Soft Drink
